findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: There were several dented cans observed to be for sale on the shelf, including, but not limited to, mixed vegetables, sliced mangos, beef barley soup, fruit cocktail, and evaporated milk. CORRECTED- These items were voluntarily discarded by the PIC. It is important to remove dented cans from being sold, as dents in cans exposes the food to contamination from bacteria growth. Ensure that any dented cans are discarded of or returned to the distributor.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: There was not an ambient thermometer observed to be in the walk-in cooler/freezer. An ambient thermometer is necessary, as the digital thermometer should not be relied on. Ensure that there is an ambient thermometer placed in the warmest part of the unit (closest to the door) by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a floor drain cover missing on the drain in front of the mop sink. This drain also appears to be on the verge of backing up. Ensure that this is kept an eye on and that the drain cover is replaced. A drain cover is important due to it blocking items from going into the drain, potentially causing a sewage back-up. Ensure that this drain cover is replaced by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(B) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (B) The floors in FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain, and the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.
